land.text: Igala country round Idah: the Northern Nigeria Protectorate page lists the Igala Kingdom among its predecessors

successors.note: The Igala page heads the rulers 'Ata who ruled during British occupation' from 1900 (1900-1903 Ocheje Ameh Ocheje); the page gives no account of the end of independence.

capitals.name: Idah
capitals.note: Infobox capital Idah; the gazetteer's Idah point.

correction.text: the Igala country round Idah, ruled by the Attah through seven councils: Ankpa, Ajaka, Ugwolawo, Egume, Dekina, Omala and Olamaboro Anyigba

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. Infobox 'Established: c. 16th century?', no area; a 65 km circle round Idah (about 13,000 km2) stands for the seven councils. The Benin pages say the Igala invaded Benin about 1515-1517; the Igala page does not mention Benin.

ledger.note: 16th century: Abutu-Eje founds the Igala kingdom. 'The Igala kingdom was founded by Abutu-Eje in the 16th century'; infobox 'Established: c. 16th century?'; the rulers list opens with a Kwararafa Dynasty. The page gives no year.

1900: the Igala kingdom passes under British occupation. The page lists 'Ata who ruled during British occupation' from 1900 (1900-1903: Ocheje Ameh); the Northern Nigeria Protectorate page (established 1 January 1900) lists the Igala Kingdom among its predecessors. The page does not describe the occupation.
1900: sovereign Igala ends; the Attah continues as a traditional ruler (1905-1911 Ameh Oboni Akwu; 10 March 2013 - 27 August 2020 Idakwo Om Ameh Om Oboni).

wars.name: Igala invasion of Benin
wars.outcome: Benin defeated the Igala invasion (the Esigie page puts the war 'between approximately 1515 and 1517'; Curnow 1519-1521); Idah's defeat is dated about 1517.
wars.note: The Igala page does not mention Benin or Esigie.

sources.title: Igala Kingdom
sources.note: Capital Idah; founded by Abutu-Eje in the 16th century; seven councils; rulers during British occupation from 1900; no area, no Benin war, no end of independence.

sources.title: Northern Nigeria Protectorate
sources.note: Igala Kingdom among the predecessors of the protectorate (1 January 1900).

notes: The Igala Kingdom has no Cliopatria row. Three pages (two shared). The Igala page is thin: no founding year (the 1500 start is a bridge for 'c. 16th century'), no area, nothing on Benin and nothing on how independence ended; the 1900 end rests on the rulers heading 'Ata who ruled during British occupation' and on the Northern Nigeria page's predecessor list. Idah lies south of Lokoja, where the Southern Nigeria page puts the border of the Royal Niger Company's southern lands, so the successor could be the Southern Nigeria Protectorate (niger-coast-protectorate); a gap-filler should check.
